note:
New gate. 145 order-line writes of `product_uom_qty` in the odoo checkout: 56 that change behaviour (a create of any quantity but 1 silently becomes 1; every `write` desynchronises the two fields) and 89 creates of 1, inert because the default absorbs them and still the wrong field.

The floor is set after this change's own fixes, not before them. The five modules touched here, measured at the parent commit through `--roots` over a `git archive` of the same paths, against the same five now:

  mrp_subcontracting_purchase   3 -> 0
  sale_mrp                     24 -> 18
  sale_mrp_margin               1 -> 0
  sale_stock_margin             3 -> 0
                               -----------
                               31 -> 18

so the parent measures 158 and this commit 145. The six left in sale_mrp are creates of 1, inert; the thirteen removed are the ones that changed behaviour. The two model-side reads repaired here -- sale_mrp._compute_qty_transferred and purchase_mrp's two copies of it -- are reads, not writes, and the gate does not count them.

pos_sale alone holds 50 of the 145 and is the obvious next unit.

Command: python tooling/architecture/order_line_qty.py --count
